name: Search Spike During Holiday Promotion
stimulus: Users perform flight+hotel searches at 20x normal rate for 30 minutes
response: Search remains available; p95 search response time < 1.2s; error rate < 1%

name: Prevent Double Booking Under Concurrency
stimulus: Multiple users attempt to book the last remaining seat/room simultaneously
response: System prevents double booking using reservation/locking; confirmed bookings are consistent within 5 seconds

name: Partner API Outage During Booking
stimulus: Airline partner API intermittently fails while payment is successful
response: Booking is recovered via retries/compensation; user sees correct status; no orphaned charges

name: Add New Payment Provider
stimulus: Business adds a new payment provider and routing rules by country
response: Payment integration is added with minimal impact on booking logic and deployed within 2 days

name: Fraud Detection and Audit for Bookings
stimulus: Security team requests audit trail for booking creation, payment attempts, and account changes
response: Actions are authenticated and authorized; audit logs are complete and retained for 12 months
